rationale.conceptual: The method involves only standard algebraic formulas (weighted sums, entropy from ideal mixing, atomic-size difference, etc.) that are commonly taught in materials science. No novel algorithm, machine learning, or domain-specific complexity; it is a straightforward application of published empirical models.
